title: A transformer-based deep learning model for predicting the use of atherectomy devices during PCI from preprocedural cardiac computed tomography angiography.
summary: A CNN–Transformer model estimated atherectomy use from CCTA and was tested at two independent institutions, a defined procedural-planning result without patient-outcome evidence. Published in European Heart Journal - Digital Health.
ai_technology: CNN image features plus Transformer multiple-instance learning predicted atherectomy use from preprocedural CCTA.
organization: Department of Cardiovascular Medicine, Kyushu University Hospital , 3-1-1 Maidashi, Higashi-ku, Fukuoka 812-8582 ,; Department of Advanced Information Technology, Kyushu University , Fukuoka ,; Department of Cardiovascular Medicine, Tokai University Hachioji Hospital , Tokyo ,; Department of Cardiovascular Medicine, New Tokyo Hospital , Matsudo ,

evidence.tested: Multicentre training/validation and external institution test; predicts clinician/device use, not patient outcome.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study.
evidence.ai_role: CNN image features plus Transformer multiple-instance learning predicted atherectomy use from preprocedural CCTA.
